authority: Owner direct instruction: deploy Codex to BLACK
command:
set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
printf 'AMX_CODEX_INSTALL_START\n'
printf 'user=%s\n' "$(id -un)"
printf 'home=%s\n' "$HOME"
printf 'node='; node --version
printf 'npm='; npm --version
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"
npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.local" @openai/codex@latest
CODEX_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/codex"
test -x "$CODEX_BIN"
printf 'codex_bin=%s\n' "$CODEX_BIN"
"$CODEX_BIN" --version
PROFILE="$HOME/.profile"
LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"'
touch "$PROFILE"
grep -Fqx "$LINE" "$PROFILE" || printf '\n%s\n' "$LINE" >> "$PROFILE"
printf 'profile_path_persisted=true\n'
printf 'AMX_CODEX_INSTALL_COMPLETE\n'
